descriptor.anonymous: Fifteen or so people of mixed ages in a city park at lunchtime, clustered in twos and threes, each cluster sharing something on a phone. None is a canon character.
descriptor.scene: Fifteen or so people are the subject, scattered across a sunny city park at lunchtime in clusters of two and three, and in every single cluster one person is holding a phone out and the others are leaning in and laughing. The same laughter repeats across the park like a wave, cluster after cluster, near to far. Screens are soft unreadable glows. Sandwiches, bikes leaned on benches, a fountain. If the park is empty of people the image is wrong.
descriptor._caption: Then everyone's friends showed up in one place, and a thing people loved could be passed along a million times by lunch.
